name: sanctuary-light
description: Lightkey-inspired visual lighting controller for an ETC Ion / Eos console (OSC).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared && tsc -p server && tsc -p web
